name: Clockin Kentucky 2025

venue.name: Private Clubhouse

information: If you cannot attend, please cancel your registration so that someone on the waitlist can attend instead. Because of the small competitor limit, every competitor MUST help throughout the day for the competition to stay on schedule. If you are finished competing we encourage you to stay until the end to help with running, judging, and scrambling the final few groups. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcXBEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3440ef949907336b2807b1eb73f2734f6349e226/image.png)
